rules: Use tight letter spacing for headings (tracking-tight) to create a dense, technical aesthetic.
Overlines and labels MUST be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Font weights: Rely on extreme contrast (e.g., 300 Light vs 700 Bold).
NO purple gradients. NO generic SaaS blue.
Use solid dark colors. Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Use 1px borders (border-white/10) for structure, no soft shadows.
Hover states must increase contrast and text visibility explicitly (e.g. hover:text-black hover:bg-primary).
Focus states must have sharp, high-contrast rings (ring-1 ring-primary ring-offset-1 ring-offset-background).

surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look): Expose the skeleton. Make the grid visible using border-collapse or grid items with border-r border-b border-border.
Retro-Futurism / Terminal Look: Deep black background, visible grid lines, no shadows. Use monospace fonts extensively for data.
Dashboard Cards: Cardless style or flat backgrounds (bg-surface). 1px subtle border, strictly no shadows. On hover, use a sharp 1px offset translation rather than soft shadow.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle global noise/grain overlay to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use Framer Motion for agent step transitions. Staggered list animations for logs. Use `layoutId` for smooth transitions between pipeline states.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use ASCII art or simple monospace diagrams (like CLI tools) for empty states rather than generic vector illustrations.

rules: Base Grid: h-screen flex or grid layout (no global scrolling). Inner panels handle their own scrolling (overflow-y-auto) to mimic an IDE/Mission Control.
Left Panel (Width ~25%): Input forms (SRS/URL) & Agent Orchestration Reasoning Log (Live Progress).
Center Panel (Width ~50%): Live Preview Engine (Rendered HTML/CSS wireframes) / Happy-path Flow Diagram.
Right Panel (Width ~25%): Context / Output Panel (UX Rating report, Finalize & Export options, Code view).
Use standard Tailwind grid gaps (gap-0) but manage borders manually to create a seamless paneled UI.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none), flat colors. Primary action uses bg-primary text-black. Interaction: translate-x/y on click.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn components stripped of rounded corners (rounded-none), using monospace font, 1px borders, subtle focus rings.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless style. Delineate space using 1px borders (border-border).
components_strategy.tabs: Minimalist underline style or sharp block style. No rounded pill tabs.

key_features_guidelines.super_agent_orchestration_panel: Design as a terminal/log window. Use monospace text, color-coded tags for different agents (e.g., [UX_AGENT], [UI_AGENT]). Show pulsing text cursor or indicator for active agent.
key_features_guidelines.live_wireframe_preview: Center stage. A framed 'browser window' style container to show the live HTML/CSS output. Include click-through navigation controls and toggle between 'Flow Diagram' and 'Live Render'.
key_features_guidelines.ux_rating_report: Data-heavy presentation. Use horizontal progress bars or segmented block charts with stark contrasts (destructive red for issues, success green for good). Justify scores with monospace text blocks.
key_features_guidelines.input_panel: Dual mode: Paste SRS text or enter Website URL (Crawl). Show a distinct, technical 'INITIALIZE_ORCHESTRATOR' button.
key_features_guidelines.finalize_export: Slide-out or right-hand pane. Display generated code blocks (React + CSS, API spec) with syntax highlighting. Prominent 'EXPORT_ARTIFACTS' action.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: 'Chivo' and 'JetBrains Mono'. Update tailwind.config.js to include these fonts.
Structure the main layout as an IDE-like interface: absolute full screen (h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden) with flex/grid panels that have internal scrolling.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn but override border radii to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`.
Implement the agent reasoning logs with a typewriter effect or staggered reveal to feel 'live' and computational.
Do NOT center align the app container. Ensure strict left-aligned structure across all textual data.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics like rounded purple buttons with stars.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through border hierarchy and layout spacing, not soft drop shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties (e.g., transform, opacity).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (sharp corners for this theme) with fast interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, tight transitions.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
